BMO · BMO

BMO: U.S. returns must earn the valuation premium

Credit normalization and capital efficiency are rebuilding earnings. At more than twice July common book, the share price also requires lasting improvement in the return on capital committed to the U.S. franchise.

BNS · Scotiabank

Scotiabank: a better bank still needs a sensible entry price

The turnaround is producing stronger earnings, but a price near twice July common book already anticipates more. Canadian funding, international credit and capital discipline determine whether the recovery can persist.

CM · CIBC

CIBC: stronger returns, less room for an easy rerating

Improved Canadian profitability and a steadier U.S. business strengthen the franchise. The valuation now requires those returns to persist after tax benefits, transaction charges and provision releases are normalized.

TD · TD

TD: recovery has a price; controls still matter

What you can test

Each new article includes an FY2026–FY2028 operating bridge, bear/base/bull valuation, EPS and P/E sensitivity, an ROE/book cross-check, a credit-cost stress calculator and five-year cash-flow returns. Source links and downloadable model inputs accompany the analysis. Future results and dividends remain uncertain.
